parole.significato: a lily of the valley (plant, wild flower (genus Convallaria))
parole.testo: Borrowed from Latin lilium convallium, a calque of Biblical Hebrew שׁוֹשַׁנַּת הָעֲמָקִים (šôšannat hāʿămāqîm) through the Vulgate. Similar to English lily of the valley and Norwegian Nynorsk liljekonvall.
